title: La Casa de la Mancha
medium: Etching with aquatint on Whatman wove paper

said.q: Motherwell created this piece in 1984, just seven years before his death. The artist's signature black drawing lines are on full display against a radiant orange backdrop balanced between thin geometric lines and thicker gestural forms.
said.by: Elizabeth Clement Fine Art, on Artsy

events.q: Motherwell created this piece in 1984, just seven years before his death.

events.q: Editions of La Casa de la Mancha are held by notable private and museum collections including the Walker Art Center in Minneapolis, the Portland Art Museum, and the Provincetown Art Association and Museum.
